slots.title: Analytical closed-form solutions for seismic site response in terms of accelerations
slots.instruction: For a homogeneous, fine-grained, saturated stratum of thickness $H_s$, with depth-variable shear modulus $G_o(z)$ reaching its maximum at the base ($G_o = G(z=0)$), resting on rock, and subjected to base accelerations $a_g(t)$: investigate and compile the various analytical (closed-form) formulations of site response that express instantaneous accelerations $a(z,t)$ at different points within the stratum.

slots.title: Closed-form shear strain equations derived from the acceleration field
slots.instruction: Starting from the instantaneous acceleration field $a(z,t)$ at any point in the stratum, derive the closed-form equations for shear strains $\gamma(z,t)$, defined as the derivative of the response with respect to depth $z$.

constraints: The output document language is English.
The document follows professional engineering methodology style.
